suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Repair the configured model strings for `scrutiny-feature-reviewer` and fallback reviewer droids used by scrutiny so Task-based reviewer launches succeed in future milestones.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: During this rerun, every Task launch for both `scrutiny-feature-reviewer`, `codebase-validation-specialist`, and even `worker` failed immediately with `Invalid model: custom:GPT-5.4-Medium-[VibeProxy]-25`, so review artifacts had to be produced manually in the validator session.
